title: Membership query count for restricted weight
statement: Let the input be a restricted-weight input with positive dimension, positive accuracy numerator, accuracy at most $1/2$, and Fourier bound at least one. For any finite set $S$, the membership-query component of the deterministic restricted-weight cost is the product of the outer and inner sample counts.
hypotheses_covered: twice the accuracy numerator is at most its denominator
Fourier bound is at least one
